answer: Each epoch the protocol reselects a jury by seed: five established peers with no kin edge to the author, each staking a 50-POA bond behind a verdict. A juror whose score lands outside the final median forfeits that bond, so a lazy panel costs real tokens. Buying 1,000 friendly attestations fails: every fake answer meets strangers reselected each round. A wharf runs the same rule in a gale: no sonnet of credentials gets a hull past the jetty, the harbourmaster ties you off or your paperwork spirals, and the signal up the mast is one berth or nothing.
